title: $500 a month can make you a millionaire
caption:
$500 a month is $6,000 a year.
Invested at 8% a year for 35 years, that grows to about $1,033,901.
Start early and let it compound.
comment: How much could you invest each month? 👇
sources: Math: $6,000 a year at 8% for 35 years, end-of-year deposits: 6,000 × ((1.08^35 − 1) / 0.08) = 1,033,901
